overall: The AG found the Winchester Audit Advisory Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by never creating or approving minutes, ordered compliance and reconstructed minutes from 2010, and declined the mission and records issues.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the advisory committee had taken no minutes of any public or executive session since its May 2006 creation.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to create and approve minutes of its meetings.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee failed to carry out the charge of its mission as stated in 2006 Board of Selectmen minutes.
allegations.key_passage: We make no finding with respect to Mr. Castignetti's allegation that the Committee failed to carry out the charge of its mission, as that is not a matter within the scope of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint sought documents under the Public Records Law; the AG made no finding and pointed the requester to the Secretary of State's Public Records Division.
allegations.key_passage: Additionally, we make no finding with respect to Mr. Castignetti's request for documents under the Public Records Law.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
Create and approve minutes of all of the Committee's meetings, to the best of its ability, from July 1, 2010 to present, within 90 days of receipt of the letter
remedy_passage: we order the Conmratee to create and approve minutes of all of the Committee's meetings, to the best of its ability, from July 1, 2010 to present, within ninety (90) days of receipt of this letter.
